description: Push a refund that ALREADY exists in Final POS to the connected WooCommerce store, so the online order shows as refunded there. Takes the REFUND id from get_refunds — the order id will not work. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT BEFORE CALLING: it creates a refund on their live store, there is no undo from here, and calling it twice creates a second refund there. It does NOT move money back to the customer and it does NOT create a refund in Final POS — that happens on the POS terminal.

refundId.description: Refund id from get_refunds — not an order id

name: hub_sync_refund_to_ecommerce
title: Sync refund to store
